content.value: The focal lengths of objective and eye piece of a compound microscope are 1cm and 5cm respectively. An object of 0.1mm height is placed at a distance 1 1mm from the objective and the final image is formed at the least distance of the distinct vision from the eye piece. Find the height of the final image and also the distance of the apparatus.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2018
